description: Frozen protocol for I3.11a routing invariance stress test. Tests whether R0 (hidden_evidence_count == 0 -> M3, else -> A1) generalizes when hidden_evidence_count is deliberately crossed with task semantics.
research_question: Does hidden_evidence_count == 0 itself predict MDSG applicability (H1), or does it merely identify conflict_unresolved in the current generator (H2)?

r0_router.leakage_assertion: assert_r0_leakage verifies only hidden_evidence_count is used

corpus.description: Decorrelated corpus crossing hidden_evidence_count with task semantics

critical_test_cases.conflict_unresolved_with_hidden_gt_0: If H1: M3 should NOT rescue. If H2: M3 SHOULD rescue. R0 routes to A1.
critical_test_cases.answer_tasks_with_hidden_0: If H1: M3 should help. If H2: M3 should NOT help. R0 routes to M3.

arms.R0: deterministic router: hidden_evidence_count == 0 -> M3, else -> A1

primary_criteria.C1: LCB_95(U_R0 - U_A1) > 0 — R0 must beat A1
primary_criteria.C2: LCB_95(U_R0 - U_M3) > 0 — R0 must beat M3 (otherwise R0 merely approximates M3)

safety_criteria.C5: No catastrophic subgroup regression (>10pp drop vs A1 in any category)

routing_leakage_constraints.assertion: assert_r0_leakage raises ValueError if forbidden fields are present

decision_rule: If R0 passes C1 and C2, it generalizes and the hidden-count signal is real. If R0 passes C1 but not C2, it approximates M3 but doesn't improve. If R0 fails C1, the hidden-count signal was a generator proxy.
